description: Designs the application cache of an already-scoped use case — which reads are served from a copy, the key of each (every input that changes the result, the caller included), Caffeine or Redis, expiry and size per cache, every writer that must evict, failure and load when the cache is gone, serialization and metrics — into the `22-cache.md` partial, as a decorator of an outbound port. Use when the request involves a cache, @Cacheable or @CacheEvict, Caffeine, Redis as a cache, a stale read, a cache hit ratio, a cache stampede, or a read that must be faster than its source. Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `00-use-case.md` in the given folder with a `Freshness` row that states a tolerance, plus `10-domain.md` — and stops without them.
